fixes.explanation: John doesn't describe anything dark here, friend. He says the sea of glass is “…as clear as crystal.” Night isn't in the picture. Crystal is.
I can picture that, friend, but that's not what the verse says. The elders “…cast their crowns before the throne…” The verse puts the crowns before the throne, and that's the answer.

John does weep, friend, so this one is true. He says, “And I began to weep bitterly, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.” John, who is seeing all this, tells us himself. The tears come right after the angel asks who is worthy and John hears that no one was found.

Angels are in this scene, baker, and the mighty angel was just asking the question. But the verse doesn't mention a sword. John sees “…a Lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne…”

Not quite, friend. The verse says, “And He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the One seated on the throne.” The Lamb comes and takes the scroll Himself. The verse doesn't mention the mighty angel bringing it.
